config.hypothesis: A separate scratch crop CNN trained with real field photos improves joint 177-label field predictions when the original condition scores are preserved inside every crop.
config.control: same randomly initialized architecture, same number of training occurrences per crop and the same epoch count; additional occurrences are replayed master examples.
config.stopping: Run seed 434 as a six-epoch matched screen. Repeat seed 435 only if the registered gates pass. Any deployable candidate needs a newly sealed multi-crop field confirmation. None of the course or follow-up test data is used here.
